🏛️ Venue & Directions

The Summer School will take place at the
University of Tennessee Institute for Advanced Materials & Manufacturing (IAMM)
2641 Osprey Vista Way, Knoxville, TN 37920

No parking pass is required. Free street parking is available throughout the UT Research Park.

📍 Venue Location

IAMM Headquarters
2641 Osprey Vista Way
Knoxville, TN 37920

Open in Google Maps Open in Apple Maps
The Institute for Advanced Materials & Manufacturing (IAMM) is located within the UT Research Park at Cherokee Farm, just across the river from the main UT campus. Free street parking is available throughout the Research Park — no parking pass required.
